title: M.G.L. c. 94C, 247 CMR and 105 CMR 700.000 add no retail-sale requirements for scheduled listed chemical products
subtopic: Massachusetts provisions searched for scheduled listed chemical product requirements
rule_summary: As of 2026-09-16, none of the Massachusetts statutes and regulations searched adds a requirement for the retail sale of scheduled listed chemical products, the products containing ephedrine, pseudoephedrine or phenylpropanolamine that are regulated by 21 U.S.C. 830(d)-(e), 21 U.S.C. 844(a) and 21 CFR part 1314: no section of M.G.L. c. 94C, no chapter of the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's regulations at 247 CMR 2.00 through 21.00, and no section of the Department of Public Health's regulation at 105 CMR 700.000 addresses these products or adds a requirement to those federal requirements.
exam_relevance: Tests that M.G.L. c. 94C, the Board's regulations at 247 CMR and the Department's regulation at 105 CMR 700.000 add no quantity limit, age limit, logbook or other retail requirement to the federal requirements for these products.

authority.name: 247 CMR: Board of Registration in Pharmacy

common_confusions: Assuming that M.G.L. c. 94C, 247 CMR or 105 CMR 700.000 imposes its own quantity limit, age limit or logbook for these products in addition to the federal requirements.
verification_notes: On 2026-09-16 the Laws search on malegislature.gov returned no results for pseudoephedrine, ephedrine or phenylpropanolamine; every section of M.G.L. c. 94C was searched for references to these products and to listed chemicals; and 105 CMR 700.000 (the edition published in Mass. Register #1514, 2/2/2024) and each chapter of 247 CMR listed in the mass.gov 247 CMR law library were read from the official mass.gov PDFs.
